en.headline: More than 70 Hong Kong-Taiwan flights cancelled as Super Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: As of Friday afternoon, services by Cathay Pacific, HK Express and others to Taoyuan, Kaohsiung and Taichung have been scrapped, with the storm’s peak impact lasting through the night.
body: More than 70 flights between Hong Kong and Taiwan have been cancelled as Super Typhoon Champi approaches the island, with peak impact expected through Friday night.

As of noon on Friday, more than 30 flights to and from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport were cancelled, along with nine outbound services to Kaohsiung and Taichung airports. Affected carriers include Cathay Pacific, HK Express, Hong Kong Airlines, Starlux Airlines, China Airlines and EVA Air.
The Hong Kong airport and airlines have advised passengers to check the latest status of their flights. Several carriers said they would waive change fees for those affected by the disruption.

zh.headline: 超強颱風薔琵逼近 逾70班港台航班取消
zh.dek: 截至周五下午，國泰、香港快運等航空公司往返桃園、高雄及台中的航班已取消，風暴高峰影響持續至晚間。
body: 超強颱風薔琵逼近台灣之際，逾七十班來往香港與台灣的航班已被取消，預料高峰影響將持續至周五晚間。
截至周五中午，往返台灣桃園國際機場的航班有超過三十班取消，另有九班前往高雄及台中機場的航班亦告取消。受影響的航空公司包括國泰航空、香港快運、香港航空、星宇航空、中華航空及長榮航空。
機場及航空公司呼籲乘客留意最新航班狀況。部分航空公司表示，會為受影響乘客豁免更改機票費用。
